title: GCA Title 16, Chapter 15: Speed or Acceleration Contests
text:
16GCAVEHICLES
CH.15SPEED OR ACCELERATION CONTESTS
CHAPTER 15
SPEED OR ACCELERATION CONTESTS
§ 15101. Permit.
§ 15102. Liability.
§ 15101. Permit.
Any person, group, club or association desiring to engage in vehicle
speed or acceleration contests on public or private property shall make
application to the Director for a permit for any such contest. The permit
herein provided may contain, but should not be limited to, conditions as to
the location of such contests, safety regulations, supervision and speed
limitations.
SOURCE: GC § 23560, enacted by P.L. 10-45.
§ 15102. Liability.
Issuance of any permit under the foregoing section shall not in anyway
cause the Government to be liable for accidents or injuries occurring in any
authorized speed or acceleration contest.
SOURCE: GC § 23561, enacted by P.L. 10-45.
NOTE: GC § 23562, Prohibition enacted by P.L. 10-45, was repealed by P.L. 13-
187:166.
